title: 3-Day Advance Notice Requirement
body: All vehicle reservations must be placed at least 3 days prior to your desired pickup time.

title: Advance Deposit Confirmation
body: Advance booking deposit of Rs. 1,000 for bikes/scooters or Rs. 2,000 for cars/vans must be paid to confirm vehicle allocation.

title: Fuel Policy
body: Vehicles are provided with fuel and must be returned with the same fuel level as given.

title: Mileage Limit & Extra Charge
body: Every 24-hour cycle comes with 200 free kilometers. Additional distance is charged at the vehicle's extra km rate.

title: Security Deposit
body: A refundable security deposit (Bikes: Rs. 5,000 | Cars: Rs. 10,000-20,000 | Vans: Rs. 15,000) is collected at pickup and refunded upon inspection on return.

title: Prohibited Activities
body: Sub-renting, race driving, off-roading, or operating the vehicle under the influence of alcohol or drugs is strictly prohibited.
